user.title: What to add
user.description: A supply computes the cost of one contract. The GME account downloads the PUN for every supply, with your own GME credentials.

contract_source.title: Supply contract
contract_source.description: Look up the offer code printed on your bill among the offers published on the Portale Offerte, or paste the contract as JSON if the offer is not there.

offer_code.title: Offer code
offer_code.description:
Type the offer code printed on your bill, in the box describing your offer: 32 letters and digits. Spaces and letter case do not matter. The offers are those published on the Portale Offerte of ARERA and Acquirente Unico, current and past, converted by electrITHA.

{details}

offer_contract.title: Contract of the offer

contract.title: Supply contract
contract.description:
Paste the contract as JSON. It holds only what your supplier decides: prices, fees, how dispatching is billed. The README explains the format and how to get it from a bill.

{details}

supply.title: Supply and meters
supply.description: These do not depend on the supplier. You find them on any bill.

data_description.resident: Decides the excise allowance and the fixed system charge.
data_description.power_kw: The contracted power (potenza impegnata), in kW.
data_description.meters: One or more cumulative energy sensors that measure what you draw from the grid. Their increases are added together.

market.title: Market values
market.description: Your contract is priced with the values below, which change every month. For each one choose an entity or type a fixed number in €/kWh, not both. An entity may report €/kWh or €/MWh. The sensors of the GME account, if you added it, are already filled in. Leave dispatching, capacity market and CDispD empty to use the values Terna and ARERA publish, downloaded once a day.

gme_account.title: GME account
gme_account.description: The PUN is downloaded from the official GME API with your own credentials, which GME gives each user who registers at {url}. The password GME sends by email cannot be used as is: change it first at {password_url}, then enter the new one below. GME requires changing it again every 6 months; when it refuses the saved password, Home Assistant will ask you to log in again here. Data source: Gestore dei Mercati Energetici S.p.A.

reauth_confirm.title: GME account
reauth_confirm.description: GME refused the saved credentials: most likely the password expired (GME requires changing it every 6 months) or was changed on purpose. Change it at {password_url} if you have not already, then enter it again. If you lost it, recover it from the same page, or ask GME (registration at {url}).

error.invalid_contract: The contract is not valid. The problems are listed above.
error.entity_or_value: Fill in either the entity or the fixed value, not both.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the GME API. Try again later.
error.offers_unavailable: Cannot download the offers of the Portale Offerte. Try again later, or close this window, start again and choose to paste the contract as JSON.
error.offer_not_found: No offer with this code. Check it on the bill; if it is right, the Portale has not published that offer: close this window, start again and choose to paste the contract as JSON.
error.offer_unsupported: This offer cannot be converted to a contract, for the reasons listed above: close this window, start again and choose to paste the contract as JSON.

abort.already_configured: The GME account is already configured.

published_download_failed.title: electrITHA cannot download the official market values
published_download_failed.description: Since {since}, electrITHA has not managed to download the dispatching, capacity market and CDispD values that Terna and ARERA publish, from {url}. Costs are computed with the last values it has, updated on {updated}: a month whose own values are missing uses the latest published ones instead. Check that Home Assistant can reach GitHub. This message goes away by itself at the first download that works.
